description:
A simplified touch optimized interface for QGIS in the field.


What's Changed
- Add ability to append a description when create a cloud project through template or cloning
- Support geographic CRSes for 3D map views
- Fix presence in the value relation editor items list
- Show a busy overlay while printing to let users know a process is ongoing
- Additional improvements to BLE connection transfer rate of NTRIP corrections
- Fix geometry digitizing issue when auto-save is enabled
- Enable the "compress project and send" action for cloud projects
- Provide UI feedback when project cloudification fails (e.g. missing a project file, multiple project files found, etc.)
- Fix saving/loading of QFieldCloud cookies
- Avoid clearing authentication configuration when QFieldCloud host is unreachable or timed out
- Fix translation issues with the local datasets & projects panel
- Update translation files
iOS-specific changes
- Update sentry-cocoa to the last 7.X series version
- Fix failed connection to TLS 1.3 SSL servers by switching Qt's SSL backend to openssl
- Update iOS target to 17.0 to align with upstream Qt 6.10 minimum requirements
- Let Qt handle default rendering surface settings
Full Changelog: v4.3.1...v4.3.2
